question: Add a record for Outscraper's Test Drive program (1-year free-tier credits for companies and startups)?
why: https://outscraper.com/test-drive/ offers 1-year free access to Outscraper services; an application asks name, title, company name, company size, industry, intended use and a corporate email of an account already created, and credits are added once the request is approved. A contributor on the Outscraper Python SDK repository names it as the route to test the API without adding a payment method or credits. It is a separate offer with its own identity (a corporate email and an approval) and its own tier; a discover unit adds it as crawler-scraper/outscraper-test-drive, tier test drive.
